conventions.convention: Images have M≥1 patches with q≥1 real values each; empirical datasets have n≥1 images. Masked reconstruction requires 1≤k<M. V denotes visible positions, sampled uniformly among size-k subsets; loss averages only over the complement, with denominator (M−k)q.

Patch normalization uses variance q⁻¹ times the sum of squared deviations. Every normalized empirical target patch must have positive standard deviation. Population normalization requires this simultaneously for all patches almost surely, with measurable loss extended by zero on the exceptional null event. Raw targets have no positive-variance restriction.
Population losses are measurable nonnegative random variables whose expectations may be infinite; the population masked objective averages over an independent uniform mask.
The encoder receives visible patches and their positions without mask tokens. The decoder receives all positions, using one shared learned mask vector at missing positions.

The update budget J is a nonnegative integer; iterations run from t=0 through J−1. Optimizer maps preserve the parameter/state domain, and every reached loss must have a finite parameter gradient. No convergence or semantic-sufficiency guarantee is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: For 1≤k<M, the masked loss is ((M−k)q)⁻¹ times the sum, over j outside V, of squared errors between the predicted patch and T(x_j). Its population objective uniformly averages the expected loss over size-k visible sets; its empirical objective uniformly averages over training images and those visible sets. Normalized targets require positive patch standard deviations, with the stated almost-sure restriction and null-event extension for population losses.

For each t=0,…,J−1, sample a uniform training index and an independent uniform size-k visible set, encode visible patches only, insert shared mask tokens at missing positions, decode all positions, compute masked-target MSE and its parameter gradient, and apply the supplied optimizer update. Return the trained encoder and final parameter vector.
